svg.title: Доброе утро сидя со штангой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated barbell good morning in strict three-quarter side view. SAME athlete seated astride a low FLAT bench in both panels, buttocks stay firmly on bench; feet wide apart and flat on floor. ONE straight barbell with small round weight plates at both ends rests horizontally behind head across upper back and rear shoulders. Hands grip bar to stabilize, no arm action. LEFT: seated upright. RIGHT: hinge from hips, torso inclines forward over lap with straight neutral back, hips stay in contact with bench, same feet in same places, bar stays across upper back. No standing, no squat, no rack. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
